newsitem.title: CHINA: China completes design of nuclear reactor.
newsitem.headline: China completes design of nuclear reactor.

text.p: China has completed the design of a 1,000-megawatt nuclear reactor in cooperation with foreign companies, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
The reactor, the most powerful to be developed yet in China, would be widely used in China's commercial nuclear power plants, it said.
The foreign companies involved in the reactor's design included the Westinghouse Electric Corp of the U.S., Spain's Netec and Japan's Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Ltd, it said.
The foreign companies would also provide the nuclear steam supply system and steam engine units for the reactor, it said.
The two Chinese partners in the project were the East China Electric Power Design Institute and the Shanghai Nuclear Engineering Research and Design Institute, it said.
China has said it expects installed capacity of its nuclear power stations to rise by 400 percent to 9,000 megawatts by 2003.
